In view of Sankranti Festival–2026, heavy vehicular movement is expected across Hyderabad City due to large-scale travel towards Andhra Pradesh and Telangana districts. 
Peak traffic: Jan 9–13 
Return traffic: Jan 16–19, 2026 

Moderate traffic congestion likely at:
• Kachiguda & Secunderabad Railway Stations
• MGBS – Aramghar (via Afzalgunj–City College–Puranapool–Bahadurpura)
• S.R. Nagar – Lakdikapool
• Rethibowli – Aramghar (via Attapur)
• Kachiguda – Ramanthapur
• MGBS – Dilsukhnagar

Advisory to Commuters:
• Plan travel in advance
• Avoid peak hours
• Use alternate routes
• Start early for bus/rail journeys
• Prefer Public Transport & Metro Rail
 Follow traffic signage & cooperate with traffic police

📲 Live Traffic Updates:
👉 Facebook: Hyderabad Traffic Police
👉 X (Twitter): @HYDP

📞 Traffic Helpline: 9010203626
Hyderabad Traffic Police request public cooperation for a safe & smooth Sankranti travel.
